data.name: Hurl
data.detailed_description:
Hurl is a fast-paced, skill-based arcade sports game focused on Hurling, the fastest field sport in the world.

Players compete in 5v5 matches, clashing with opponents as they pull on the ball using unbelievable skills to score astonishing points.

The unique mechanics of the sport of Hurling are transformed on-screen where players must perfectly time hitting the sliotar (ball), first tapping it up into the air and then unleashing it at the opposition goal posts.

Use your hurley to block and hook your opponent's shots or simply side pull them into the bounding walls of the arena in dynamic, short-form matches.

It features playable fantasy characters taken directly out of Irish mythology, the likes of Queen Maeve and Finn McCool, and arenas inspired by the natural beauty of the island of Ireland, such as the Giant's Causeway and the Cliffs of Moher.

Make your way across the island defeating these mythical heroes to unlock them and their special abilities for use in matches.

Play solo, with friends or against sworn enemies and get ready to Hurl!

data.short_description: ARCADE HURLING! Play as the mythological giants of Irish mythology and beyond, with playable characters such as Queen Maeve and Finn McCool. Feel the speed of the world's fastest sport and experience the physicality first hand with bone crunching tackles and skill based special moves.

  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
